notes.title: Version Update 0.9.6
notes.notes:
Long time no see. Life has been a bit turbulent lately, so the update schedule has changed. However, please stay tuned. I can’t guarantee the time, but I will finish making this game. 


[b]General Changes: [/b]
[b]- Reduced the brightness of side UI. [/b]
[b]- Lowered the brightness and increased the size of player bullets. [/b]
[b]- Replaced the player's fire effects. [/b]
	These changes aim to make the game less visually overwhelming. 
	I’m not good with visual design and color management. There’s still a lot to tweak, and I’ll take it slow. 

[b]- Rewrote most timing-related code to reduce performance overhead. [/b]
	This required resetting parameters, which might lead to gameplay difference compared to before. 

[b]- Redesigned aiming mechanics to reduce performance overhead. [/b]
	The new implementation should be more efficient, but it’s hard to replicate the exact feel of the old system, so the handling might feel different. 

This improves 1% low framerate by 5%. This can be an error due to limited test samples. 
That said, my abilities are limited. If you encounter any issues, please reply to let me know. 


[b]Gameplay Changes: [/b]
[b]- Minimum rate status in O/U Mode increased from x1 to x4. [/b]
[b]- Rank reduction from suicide bullets creation in O/U Mode doubled. [/b]
	This lowers the barrier to entry and addresses energy shortages. 

[b]- Phase 2 Overload now only displays percentages in the left UI, rather than specific values. [/b]
	Since the accumulation varies by mode, I feel it’s better to let players figure it out for themselves. 

[b]- Player ship ACX-2 now closes its slaves at low speeds to reduce bullet spread. [/b]
	Previously this ship was terrible for focusing fire, making it a joke against high-HP units, so I changed it. 

[b]- Boss 1 Phase 1 final pattern weakened in AL Mode, AO Mode, and O Mode. [/b]
	This pattern weren’t meant to be seen, but the patterns for AL Mode and U Mode shouldn’t be the same, so I nerfed it. 

[b]- Boss 3 Phase 1 no longer rotates left and right. [/b]
	The original intention was to add cinematic flair, but given my current limitations, I’ll shelve this for now. 

[b]- Constant rings are now displayed in O/U Mode, showing the x16 and x8 distances. [/b]
	My initial concern was cluttering the screen, but now I think it’s better to add them and tweak things later. 


[b]Menus: [/b]
[b]- Reworked the leaderboard and player manual interfaces. [/b]
The previous versions were too half-baked, although these are still somewhat incomplete. 
Online leaderboards now support pagination. 


[spoiler]Some older changes that weren’t included in previous patch notes: 
Little Tweaks 2024.6.21: 
[b]- Enhanced player hit effects. 
- Adjusted player bullet colors. 
- Updated 4th Boss’s mine textures. 

- DoT effects now deal damage once every 5 frames, at 5x the original amount. [/b]
	Applying damage every frame had too much performance impact, but this change might affect the gameplay experience. 
	This adjustment applies to: bombs, AoE damage, and piercing lasers. 

[b]- Enemy bullet hitboxes now take effect after a 2-frame delay. [/b]
	During testing, we encountered a situation where a player’s bomb covered the enemy’s firing point, but the player’s hitbox was still within the firing point, causing them to get hit. If this 2-frame adjustment causes other issues or doesn’t solve the problem, we might make additional changes. [/spoiler]

I truly appreciate all of your support. Whenever I feel like giving up, seeing someone playing the game I’ve made, or someone clearing Unlimited mode, gives me the motivation to keep updating. Thank you. 

Enjoy the game! 
Crystal Heart's Studio

notes.title: Version Update 0.9.5
notes.notes:
This patch merges the update from 0.9.2 to 0.9.5, that's why it took us a little more time. 

- Swap the order of Original and Arrange Original in Mode Selection Menu. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007142/8f8b1ca40b9333b6fc62d9cdfdf3137eb118d53e.png[/img]
We thought the Arrange Original Mode was more difficult before. We underestimate the influence of game system's complexities. We change this issue now because we found that most players are screwed after they finishes Arrange Light Mode and head towards Original. (Which has a much more different and complex game system)

Original Version Update 0.9.2: 
- Fix a type of medium enemy didn't initialize correctly. 
- Enemies' crash ships won't turn to player after 6 seconds. 
- Fix a type of medium enemy emit bullets from a wrong shot position. 
- Su-97A low-speed attack change, it now switches firing angle after holding ↑ or ↓ for a certain time. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007142/705149e43fb10dddcd1d3f3669ff8b50f9891bf0.gif[/img]
Because the low-speed swing attack is given to Kiruya, and Su-97A shouldn't have the same. We changed its low-speed fire to firing angle change which keeps the same design of its hi-speed attack. 

Original Version Update 0.9.3: 
- Adjust Occlusion Culling more carefully. 
Original Version Update 0.9.4: 
- Tweak object pooling and RAM garbage recover to balance the usage of CPU and RAM/VRAM. 
Original Version Update 0.9.5: 
- Fixed Air-Ground Collision switch issue, adjust some ground enemies' hitboxes. 

We wanted more changes since Version Update 0.9.2 had too little content, But we had a hard time adjusting Occlusion Culling. Due to no result in adjusting Occlusion Culling, we started tweaking object pooling and RAM garbage recover……We changed everything we want to change for now as a result. 
There can be some problems with such a huge change in the bottom logic. We try to restore the enemies' initializations and collisions, but we are not sure if we perfectly restore all of them. If there is some difference, please bear with us. 

Other changes: 
- Remake player bullet and hit effect, but player bullets' collisions remain the same. 
- Enlarge player hitbox indicator, but the real collision remains the same. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007142/8ab72b14994d6f20b6684746043909c34d9d9b0e.gif[/img]
After updating the hit effect, player's hitbox indicator can be blur in some extreme scenario. 

- Lower most particle effects' count.
- Update water asset. 
- Enlarge player bullets' hit sound effect. 
- Fix an error in right side enemy info UI. 
- Fix some display bugs in Main Menu. 
- Tweak spawn positions for some enemies in a place. 
- Getting hit/Using bomb now lowers the Rank by 6/12, instead of previous 5/10. 
- Adjust some Manual texts. 
- Now if an enemy from bonus area don't spawn, the bonus area will fail. 
- Game Clear is now recorded without a save. 
- Fix Leaderboard overwritten issue. 
- Enlarge the spacing of NGSD slaves and higher the speed of NGSD slaves. 


Enjoy,
Crystal Heart's Studio

notes.title: Version Update 0.9.1 & Graphic Setting Explanation
notes.notes:
A tiny update, but with important function. 

- Add new option [b]Texture Quality[/b] in Settings. 
- Add new option Texture Quality to in-game pause menu. 

Plus the content in this small patch, we now have 5 graphic options in total. Here is a bit explanation of them about performance influence: 
[b]Texture Quality: HIGH influence in VRAM usage. [/b]
[b]Explosion Light: Influence GPU instant usage[/b]
[b]Explosion Debris: HIGH influence in CPU usage, Influence GPU usage[/b]
[b]Volumetric Fog: Low influence in VRAM usage[/b]
[b]Ambient Occlusion: Nearly no costs[/b]

We push this patch urgently because we found that some players have decent hardware only except for RAM and VRAM. [spoiler]Yes, we are exactly talking about 1060 3G VRAM[/spoiler] In this situation, the game would run smoothly if it takes lower VRAM. We hope adding Texture Quality setting may help this issue. 


Enjoy! 
Crystal Heart's Studio

notes.title: Version Update 0.9.0 - Into Pieces
notes.notes:
Our game is now at point where we need to add new functions and fix old problems. Therefore, this update might be the largest update even compare to possible future updates. 

First, let we introduce the most impressive new function: [b]Explosion Debris[/b]
After enemies are destroyed with creating an explosion particle effect, instead of suddenly disappear, now a real-time calculated debris will be spawn. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007142/5652b3af0057fc2da47853e45082d90703f0218a.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007142/bb2d6dbd9351d41059d003c8d3ec8f741222f09d.gif[/img]
It is impressive, isn't it? This not only increases the excitement of destruction, but also satisfies the destructive desire. 
But this is done with costs. The physics for each model in debris will be calculated separately. We did some optimization but it still increases the requirement of CPU's single core performance. 

Next, we want to talk about the important thing we have mentioned before: [b]Fighters' Revision[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007142/249ed58caa83eb580bf0ede0993740f50a19235f.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007142/a34b4467579a4e281a5110f5a2a63b1e07e7707f.gif[/img]
Now [b]NGSD[/b] finally got the function that matches its name - Next Gen Space Dominance. It controls high-intelligent slaves freely. But for balance issues, the fire power is limited, and the positioning of slaves is particular. 
On the other hand, [b]Kiruya[/b] moves forward with its instability. It becomes a fighter that focusing on swing fire. We give it relatively higher fire power and this might relief the instable fire. 

We are also bringing out functions that is demanded a lot: [b]In-Game Changeable Graphics Options[/b] 
- Add setting options: [b]Explosion Debris, Volumetric Fog, and Ambient Occlusion[/b]
- Add these options to pause menu with Explosion Light in addition. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43007142/81e706401152746f25e10bef136a52249771798c.gif[/img]
Remember we said that the Explosion Debris requires more CPU's single core performance. So now, if you find it prevents the game from running fluently, or you find it distracting, you can directly open pause menu and turn those options off. 

Below are some other changes in this update: 
- Side UI now can only hide right UI stage enemy info. 
- Compensate enemies' fire effect. 
- Visually enlarges enemy bullets and player hitbox. 
- Adjust explosion particle effects. 
- Adjust rate UI. 
- Final boss now detects entering true boss or not 12 seconds earlier. 
- Add move smoke and dust to some ground enemies. 
- Redesign stage 3 background scene, slightly improves performance. 
- Adjust enemy UI health bar transparency. 
- Replaceable music. 
- Now right side UI shows correct info when start the game with Original Mode. 
- Now player will not regen health when scene is loading up. 
- The difficulty progress for Unlimited Mode in mode selection UI changed to 100% fill rate. 
- Now in Original Mode, create less suicide bullets of destroying small enemies. 

There are some important stuff in those, such as the [b]adjustment in explosion, enemies' bullets, and enemies' health bar[/b]. However, from the workload side they are just other little changes. 

We will post another event talking about "Replaceable music" soon. 


Enjoy the game!

Crystal Heart's Studio

notes.title: Version Update 0.8.2
notes.notes:
- Practice Mode now works properly. (Urgent update on Oct 20th）
- Stage 5 End-Stage-Bonus is now counted in score history. 
- Phase 2 Overload end sound effect changes. 
- Main Menu now contains unlock information. 
- Game music and sound effects volume are now changeable when in-game pause. 
- Lower all terrain render accuracy. 
- Change cloud and fog in stage 3. 
- Now in stage 3, city will not be shown before lowering altitude. 
- Revise stage 4 enemy base. 
- Update texture of final boss and true boss #1. 
- Optimize CPU usage of player's homing weapons. 
- Now in Original and Unlimited Mode, Hi-Speed ATK creates less suicide bullets. 
- New Graphics Detail option: Explosion Light. 
- Darken some enemies' textures. 
- Revise stage 5 cloud and fog. 
- Turn louder some sound effects. 

-
- This update tries to lower performance occupancy and improve game experience. 

- Changes to suicide bullets in Original and Unlimited Mode may impact scoring, but it is more about keeping the game experience for more players. This way, the Hi-Speed ATK will have more functions as well. We are really serious about changes to gameplay after launch, but such a change that improves game experience and makes more possibility will be concerned. That is why the game is still in Early Access, we hope you understand. 

- We are looking into more graphics detail options: We only want to provide those options that have large impact to performance. The "Explosion Light" causes a lot instant GPU usage, but provides nice light effects. If you want the game to run more smoothly and fluently, please turn this option to Off. This option is set to On in default. 

- We noticed that the game's executable will be incorrectly reported as PUA or harmful. We are really sorry if this impacts your game experience. We are trying to find solutions now. 


Crystal Heart's Studio
